29/******************************************************************************/

31/******************************************************************************/
32
33
34void tAllpass_init (tAllpass *const ft, Lfloat initDelay, uint32_t maxDelay,
35 LEAF *const leaf)
36{
37 tAllpass_initToPool(ft, initDelay, maxDelay, &leaf->mempool);
38}
39
40void tAllpass_initToPool (tAllpass *const ft, Lfloat initDelay,
41 uint32_t maxDelay, tMempool *const mp)
42{
43 _tMempool *m = *mp;
44 _tAllpass *f = *ft = (_tAllpass *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tAllpass), m);
45
46 f->mempool = m;
47 f->gain = 0.7f;
48 f->lastOut = 0.0f;
49
50 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&f->delay, initDelay, maxDelay, mp);
51}
52
53void tAllpass_free (tAllpass *const ft)
54{
55 _tAllpass *f = *ft;
56
57 tLinearDelay_free(&f->delay);
58 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
59}
60
61void tAllpass_setDelay (tAllpass const f, Lfloat delay)
62{
63 tLinearDelay_setDelay(f->delay, delay);
64}
65
66void tAllpass_setGain (tAllpass const f, Lfloat gain)
67{
68 f->gain = gain;
69}
70
71Lfloat tAllpass_tick (tAllpass const f, Lfloat input)
72{
73 Lfloat s1 = (-f->gain) * f->lastOut + input;
74 Lfloat s2 = tLinearDelay_tick(f->delay, s1) + (f->gain) * input;
75
76 f->lastOut = s2;
77
78 return f->lastOut;
79}

124
125Lfloat tAllpassSO_tick (tAllpassSO const f, Lfloat input)
126{
127 //DFII version, efficient but causes issues with coefficient changes happening fast (due to high gain of state variables)
128 /*
129
130 Lfloat vn = input + (f->prevSamp * -f->a1) + (f->prevPrevSamp * -f->a2);
131
132 Lfloat output = (vn * f->a2) + (f->prevSamp * f->a1) + f->prevPrevSamp;
133
134 f->prevPrevSamp = f->prevSamp;
135 f->prevSamp = vn;
136 */
137
138 //a0 = 1.0f
139 //a1 = a1
140 //a2 = a2
141 //b0 = a2
142 //b1 = a1
143 //b2 = 1.0f
144
145 //DFII Transposed version
146/*
147 Lfloat vn = (input * f->a2) + f->prevSamp;
148 f->prevSamp = (input * f->a1) + (vn * -f->a1) + f->prevPrevSamp;
149 f->prevPrevSamp = input + (vn * -f->a2);
150 return vn;]
151
152*/
153 //DFI version
154 Lfloat vn = input * f->a2 + (f->prevSamp * f->a1 + f->prevPrevSamp);
155 Lfloat output = vn + (f->prevSamp2 * -f->a1) + (f->prevPrevSamp2 * -f->a2);
156 f->prevPrevSamp = f->prevSamp;
157 f->prevSamp = input;
158 f->prevPrevSamp2 = f->prevSamp2;
159 f->prevSamp2 = output;
160
161 return output;
162}

170void tThiranAllpassSOCascade_init (tThiranAllpassSOCascade *const ft,
171 int numFilts, LEAF *const leaf)

176void tThiranAllpassSOCascade_initToPool (tThiranAllpassSOCascade *const ft,
177 int numFilts, tMempool *const mp)
178{
179 _tMempool *m = *mp;
180 _tThiranAllpassSOCascade *f = *ft = (_tThiranAllpassSOCascade *) mpool_alloc(
181 sizeof(_tThiranAllpassSOCascade), m);
182 f->mempool = m;
183 f->numFilts = numFilts;
184 f->filters = (tAllpassSO *) mpool_calloc(sizeof(tAllpassSO) * numFilts, m);
185 f->k1[0] = -0.00050469f;
186 f->k2[0] = -0.0064264f;
187 f->k3[0] = -2.8743f;
188 f->C1[0] = 0.069618f;
189 f->C2[0] = 2.0427f;
190 f->k1[1] = -0.0026580f;
191 f->k2[1] = -0.014811f;
192 f->k3[1] = -2.9018f;
193 f->C1[1] = 0.071089f;
194 f->C2[1] = 2.1074f;
195 f->isHigh = 0;
196 f->numFiltsMap[0] = numFilts;
197 f->numFiltsMap[1] = 1;
198 f->numActiveFilters = numFilts;
199 for (int i = 0; i < numFilts; i++) {
200 tAllpassSO_initToPool(&f->filters[i], mp);
201 }
202}
203
204void tThiranAllpassSOCascade_free (tThiranAllpassSOCascade *const ft)
205{
206 _tThiranAllpassSOCascade *f = *ft;
207 for (int i = 0; i < f->numFilts; i++) {
208 tAllpassSO_free(&f->filters[i]);
209 }
210 mpool_free((char *) f->filters, f->mempool); //do I need to free the pointers separately?
211 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
212}

214volatile Lfloat binTest;
215
216float tThiranAllpassSOCascade_setCoeff (tThiranAllpassSOCascade const f,
217 Lfloat dispersionCoeff, Lfloat freq,
218 Lfloat oversampling)
219{
220 f->B = dispersionCoeff;
221 f->iKey = (49.0f + 12.0f * log2f(freq * INV_440));
222 Lfloat iKey2 = (49.0f + 12.0f * log2f(freq * oversampling * INV_440));
223 //f->iKey = logf((110.0f*twelfthRootOf2) / 27.5f)/ logf(twelfthRootOf2);
224 //f->isHigh = freq > 400.0f;//switch to different coefficients for higher notes
225 //Lfloat howHigh = LEAF_mapToZeroToOneOutput(iKey2, 16.0f, 76.0f);
226 Lfloat howHigh = (iKey2 - 16.0f) * 0.03f;
227 howHigh = LEAF_clip(0.0f, howHigh, 1.0f);
228 Lfloat oneMinusHowHigh = 1.0f - howHigh;
229
230 Lfloat k1 = (f->k1[0] * oneMinusHowHigh) + (f->k1[1] * howHigh);
231 Lfloat k2 = (f->k2[0] * oneMinusHowHigh) + (f->k2[1] * howHigh);
232 Lfloat k3 = (f->k3[0] * oneMinusHowHigh) + (f->k3[1] * howHigh);
233 Lfloat C1 = (f->C1[0] * oneMinusHowHigh) + (f->C1[1] * howHigh);
234 Lfloat C2 = (f->C2[0] * oneMinusHowHigh) + (f->C2[1] * howHigh);
235 Lfloat logB = logf(f->B);
236 Lfloat temp = (k1 * logB * logB) + (k2 * logB) + k3;
237 Lfloat kd = fastExp3(temp);
238 Lfloat Cd = fastExp3((C1 * logB) + C2);
239 Lfloat D = fastExp3(Cd - (f->iKey * kd));
240 f->D = D;
241
242 Lfloat a_k = -2.0f;
243
244 a_k *= (D - 2.0f);
245 a_k /= (D - 1.0f);
246
247 a_k *= (D - 1.0f);
248 a_k /= D;
249
250 a_k *= D;
251 a_k /= (D + 1.0f);
252
253 f->a[0] = a_k;
254
255 a_k = 1.0f;
256
257 a_k *= (D - 2.0f);
258 a_k /= D;
259
260 a_k *= (D - 1.0f);
261 a_k /= (D + 1.0f);
262
263 a_k *= D;
264 a_k /= (D + 2.0f);
265
266 f->a[1] = a_k;
267
268 if (f->a[0] > 0.99f) {
269 f->a[0] = 0.99f;
270 f->a[1] = 0.01f;
271 D = 1.0f;
272 }
273 //f->a[0] = LEAF_clip(0.0f, f->a[0], 1.0f);
274 //f->a[1] = LEAF_clip(-1.999999f, f->a[1], 2.0f);
275
276 for (int i = 0; i < f->numActiveFilters; i++) {
277 tAllpassSO_setCoeff(f->filters[i], f->a[0], f->a[1]);
278 //f->filters[i]->prevSamp = 0.0f;
279 //f->filters[i]->prevPrevSamp = 0.0f;
280 //probably should adjust the gain of the internal state variables
281 // (prevSamp and prevPrevSamp) if the gain total of the two coefficients
282 // goes //up, since the internals of the allpass boosts gain and then
283 // attenuates it, so leaving huge values in there that won't be
284 // attenuated enough can make it distort or nan.
285 }
286 return D * f->numActiveFilters;
287}
288
289Lfloat tThiranAllpassSOCascade_tick (tThiranAllpassSOCascade const f, Lfloat input)
290{
291 Lfloat sample = input;
292 for (int i = 0; i < f->numActiveFilters; i++) {
293 sample = tAllpassSO_tick(f->filters[i], sample);
294 }
295 return sample;
296}

304

309/******************************************************************************/
310/* OnePole Filter */
311/******************************************************************************/
312
313
314void tOnePole_init (tOnePole *const ft, Lfloat freq, LEAF *const leaf)
315{
316 tOnePole_initToPool(ft, freq, &leaf->mempool);
317}
318
319void tOnePole_initToPool (tOnePole *const ft, Lfloat freq, tMempool *const mp)
320{
321 _tMempool *m = *mp;
322 _tOnePole *f = *ft = (_tOnePole *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tOnePole), m);
323 f->mempool = m;
324 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
325
326 f->gain = 1.0f;
327 f->a0 = 1.0;
328
329 f->lastIn = 0.0f;
330 f->lastOut = 0.0f;
331
332 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = leaf->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
333
334 tOnePole_setFreq(*ft, freq);
335}
336
337void tOnePole_free (tOnePole *const ft)
338{
339 _tOnePole *f = *ft;
340
341 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
342}
343
344void tOnePole_setB0 (tOnePole const f, Lfloat b0)
345{
346 f->b0 = b0;
347}
348
349void tOnePole_setA1 (tOnePole const f, Lfloat a1)
350{
351 if (a1 >= 1.0f) a1 = 0.999999f;
352 f->a1 = a1;
353}
354
355void tOnePole_setPole (tOnePole const f, Lfloat thePole)
356{
357 if (thePole >= 1.0f) thePole = 0.999999f;
358
359 // Normalize coefficients for peak unity gain.
360 if (thePole > 0.0f) f->b0 = (1.0f - thePole);
361 else f->b0 = (1.0f + thePole);
362
363 f->a1 = -thePole;
364}
365
366void tOnePole_setFreq (tOnePole const f, Lfloat freq)
367{
368 f->freq = freq;
369 f->b0 = f->freq * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
370 f->b0 = LEAF_clip(0.0f, f->b0, 1.0f);
371 f->a1 = 1.0f - f->b0;
372}
373
374void tOnePole_setCoefficients (tOnePole const f, Lfloat b0, Lfloat a1)
375{
376 if (b0 >= 1.0f) b0 = 0.999999f;
377 f->b0 = b0;
378 f->a1 = a1;
379}
380
381void tOnePole_setGain (tOnePole const f, Lfloat gain)
382{
383 f->gain = gain;
384}
385
386Lfloat tOnePole_tick (tOnePole const f, Lfloat input)
387{
388 Lfloat in = input * f->gain;
389 Lfloat out = (f->b0 * in) + (f->a1 * f->lastOut);
390
391 f->lastIn = in;
392 f->lastOut = out;
393
394 return out;
395}
396
397void tOnePole_setSampleRate (tOnePole const f, Lfloat sr)
398{
399 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = (1.0f / sr) * TWO_PI;
400 f->b0 = f->freq * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
401 f->b0 = LEAF_clip(0.0f, f->b0, 1.0f);
402 f->a1 = 1.0f - f->b0;
403}

438void tCookOnePole_setPole (tCookOnePole const onepole, Lfloat aValue)
439{
440 onepole->poleCoeff = aValue;
441 if (onepole->poleCoeff > 0.0f) // Normalize gain to 1.0 max
442 onepole->sgain = (1.0f - onepole->poleCoeff);
443 else
444 onepole->sgain = (1.0f + onepole->poleCoeff);
445}
446
447void tCookOnePole_setGain (tCookOnePole const onepole, Lfloat gain)
448{
449 onepole->gain = gain;
450 if (onepole->poleCoeff > 0.0f) // Normalize gain to 1.0 max
451 onepole->sgain = ((1.0f - onepole->poleCoeff) * gain);
452 else
453 onepole->sgain = ((1.0f + onepole->poleCoeff) * gain);
454}

456void tCookOnePole_setGainAndPole (tCookOnePole const onepole, Lfloat gain, Lfloat pole)
457{
458 onepole->poleCoeff = pole;
459 onepole->sgain = gain;
460}
461
462Lfloat tCookOnePole_tick (tCookOnePole const onepole, Lfloat sample)
463{
464 onepole->output = (onepole->sgain * sample) + (onepole->poleCoeff * onepole->output);
465 return onepole->output;
466}
467
468void tCookOnePole_setSampleRate (tCookOnePole const f, Lfloat sr)
469{
470 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = (1.0f / sr) * TWO_PI;
471}

488 f->mempool = m;

508Lfloat tTwoPole_tick (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat input)
509{
510 Lfloat in = input * f->gain;
511 Lfloat out = (f->b0 * in) - (f->a1 * f->lastOut[0]) - (f->a2 * f->lastOut[1]);
512
513 f->lastOut[1] = f->lastOut[0];
514 f->lastOut[0] = out;
515
516 return out;
517}
518
519void tTwoPole_setB0 (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat b0)
520{
521 f->b0 = b0;
522}
523
524void tTwoPole_setA1 (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat a1)
525{
526 f->a1 = a1;
527}
528
529void tTwoPole_setA2 (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat a2)
530{
531 f->a2 = a2;
532}
533
534void tTwoPole_setResonance (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat frequency, Lfloat radius,
535 int normalize)
536{
537 Lfloat sampleRate = f->sampleRate;
538 Lfloat twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
539
540 if (frequency < 0.0f) frequency = 0.0f;
541 if (frequency > (sampleRate * 0.49f)) frequency = sampleRate * 0.49f;
542 if (radius < 0.0f) radius = 0.0f;
543 if (radius >= 1.0f) radius = 0.999999f;
544
545 f->radius = radius;
546 f->frequency = frequency;
547 f->normalize = normalize;
548
549 f->a2 = radius * radius;
550 f->a1 = -2.0f * radius * cosf(frequency * twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
551
552 if (normalize) {
553 // Normalize the filter gain ... not terribly efficient.
554 Lfloat real = 1 - radius + (f->a2 - radius) * cosf(2 * frequency * twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
555 Lfloat imag = (f->a2 - radius) * sinf(2 * frequency * twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
556 f->b0 = sqrtf(powf(real, 2) + powf(imag, 2));
557 }
558}
559
560void tTwoPole_setCoefficients (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat b0, Lfloat a1, Lfloat a2)
561{
562 f->b0 = b0;
563 f->a1 = a1;
564 f->a2 = a2;
565}
566
567void tTwoPole_setGain (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat gain)
568{
569 f->gain = gain;
570}
571
572void tTwoPole_setSampleRate (tTwoPole const f, Lfloat sr)
573{
574 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = (1.0f / sr) * TWO_PI;
575
576 f->a2 = f->radius * f->radius;
577 f->a1 = -2.0f * f->radius * cosf(f->frequency * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
578
579 if (f->normalize) {
580 // Normalize the filter gain ... not terribly efficient.
581 Lfloat real = 1 - f->radius + (f->a2 - f->radius) * cosf(2 * f->frequency * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
582 Lfloat imag = (f->a2 - f->radius) * sinf(2 * f->frequency * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
583 f->b0 = sqrtf(powf(real, 2) + powf(imag, 2));
584 }
585}

588/******************************************************************************/
589/* OneZero Filter */
590/******************************************************************************/
591
592
593void tOneZero_init (tOneZero *const ft, Lfloat theZero, LEAF *const leaf)
594{
595 tOneZero_initToPool(ft, theZero, &leaf->mempool);
596}
597
598void tOneZero_initToPool (tOneZero *const ft, Lfloat theZero, tMempool *const mp)
599{
600 _tMempool *m = *mp;
601 _tOneZero *f = *ft = (_tOneZero *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tOneZero), m);
602 f->mempool = m;
603 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
604
605 f->gain = 1.0f;
606 f->lastIn = 0.0f;
607 f->lastOut = 0.0f;
608 f->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
609 tOneZero_setZero(*ft, theZero);
610}
611
612void tOneZero_free (tOneZero *const ft)
613{
614 _tOneZero *f = *ft;
615 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
616}
617
618Lfloat tOneZero_tick (tOneZero const f, Lfloat input)
619{
620 Lfloat in = input * f->gain;
621 Lfloat out = f->b1 * f->lastIn + f->b0 * in;
622
623 f->lastIn = in;
624
625 return out;
626}
627
628void tOneZero_setZero (tOneZero const f, Lfloat theZero)
629{
630 if (theZero > 0.0f) f->b0 = 1.0f / (1.0f + theZero);
631 else f->b0 = 1.0f / (1.0f - theZero);
632
633 f->b1 = -theZero * f->b0;
634
635}
636
637void tOneZero_setB0 (tOneZero const f, Lfloat b0)
638{
639 f->b0 = b0;
640}
641
642void tOneZero_setB1 (tOneZero const f, Lfloat b1)
643{
644 f->b1 = b1;
645}
646
647void tOneZero_setCoefficients (tOneZero const f, Lfloat b0, Lfloat b1)
648{
649 f->b0 = b0;
650 f->b1 = b1;
651}
652
653void tOneZero_setGain (tOneZero f, Lfloat gain)
654{
655 f->gain = gain;
656}
657
658Lfloat tOneZero_getPhaseDelay (tOneZero const f, Lfloat frequency)
659{
660 if (frequency <= 0.0f) frequency = 0.05f;
661
662 f->frequency = frequency;
663
664 Lfloat omegaT = 2 * PI * frequency * f->invSampleRate;
665 Lfloat real = 0.0, imag = 0.0;
666
667 real += f->b0;
668
669 real += f->b1 * cosf(omegaT);
670 imag -= f->b1 * sinf(omegaT);
671
672 real *= f->gain;
673 imag *= f->gain;
674
675 Lfloat phase = atan2f(imag, real);
676
677 real = 0.0;
678 imag = 0.0;
679
680 phase -= atan2f(imag, real);
681
682 phase = fmodf(-phase, 2 * PI);
683
684 return phase / omegaT;
685}
686
687void tOneZero_setSampleRate (tOneZero const f, Lfloat sr)
688{
689 f->invSampleRate = 1.0f / sr;
690}

693/******************************************************************************/
694/* TwoZero Filter */
695/******************************************************************************/
696
697
698void tTwoZero_init (tTwoZero *const ft, LEAF *const leaf)
699{
700 tTwoZero_initToPool(ft, &leaf->mempool);
701}
702
703void tTwoZero_initToPool (tTwoZero *const ft, tMempool *const mp)
704{
705 _tMempool *m = *mp;
706 _tTwoZero *f = *ft = (_tTwoZero *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tTwoZero), m);
707 f->mempool = m;
708 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
709
710 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = leaf->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
711 f->gain = 1.0f;
712 f->lastIn[0] = 0.0f;
713 f->lastIn[1] = 0.0f;
714}
715
716void tTwoZero_free (tTwoZero *const ft)
717{
718 _tTwoZero *f = *ft;
719 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
720}
721
722Lfloat tTwoZero_tick (tTwoZero const f, Lfloat input)
723{
724 Lfloat in = input * f->gain;
725 Lfloat out = f->b2 * f->lastIn[1] + f->b1 * f->lastIn[0] + f->b0 * in;
726
727 f->lastIn[1] = f->lastIn[0];
728 f->lastIn[0] = in;
729
730 return out;
731}
732
733void tTwoZero_setNotch (tTwoZero const f, Lfloat freq, Lfloat radius)
734{
735 // Should also deal with frequency being > half sample rate / nyquist. See STK
736 if (freq < 0.0f) freq = 0.0f;
737 if (radius < 0.0f) radius = 0.0f;
738
739 f->frequency = freq;
740 f->radius = radius;
741
742 f->b2 = radius * radius;
743 f->b1 = -2.0f * radius * cosf(freq * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate); // OPTIMIZE with LOOKUP or APPROXIMATION
744
745 // Normalize the filter gain. From STK.
746 if (f->b1 > 0.0f) // Maximum at z = 0.
747 f->b0 = 1.0f / (1.0f + f->b1 + f->b2);
748 else // Maximum at z = -1.
749 f->b0 = 1.0f / (1.0f - f->b1 + f->b2);
750 f->b1 *= f->b0;
751 f->b2 *= f->b0;
752
753}
754
755void tTwoZero_setB0 (tTwoZero const f, Lfloat b0)
756{
757 f->b0 = b0;
758}
759
760void tTwoZero_setB1 (tTwoZero const f, Lfloat b1)
761{
762 f->b1 = b1;
763}
764
765void tTwoZero_setCoefficients (tTwoZero const f, Lfloat b0, Lfloat b1, Lfloat b2)
766{
767 f->b0 = b0;
768 f->b1 = b1;
769 f->b2 = b2;
770}
771
772void tTwoZero_setGain (tTwoZero const f, Lfloat gain)
773{
774 f->gain = gain;
775}
776
777void tTwoZero_setSampleRate (tTwoZero const f, Lfloat sr)
778{
779 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = TWO_PI * (1.0f / sr);
780 tTwoZero_setNotch(f, f->frequency, f->radius);
781}

783/******************************************************************************/

788void tPoleZero_init (tPoleZero *const pzf, LEAF *const leaf)

793void tPoleZero_initToPool (tPoleZero *const pzf, tMempool *const mp)
794{
795 _tMempool *m = *mp;
796 _tPoleZero *f = *pzf = (_tPoleZero *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tPoleZero), m);
797 f->mempool = m;
798
799 f->gain = 1.0f;
800 f->b0 = 1.0f;
801
802 f->lastIn = 0.0f;
803 f->lastOut = 0.0f;
804}

806void tPoleZero_free (tPoleZero *const pzf)
807{
808 _tPoleZero *f = *pzf;

812void tPoleZero_setB0 (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat b0)
813{
814 f->b0 = b0;
815}
816
817void tPoleZero_setB1 (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat b1)
818{
819 f->b1 = b1;
820}
821
822void tPoleZero_setA1 (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat a1)
823{
824 if (a1 >= 1.0f) // a1 should be less than 1.0
825 {
826 a1 = 0.999999f;
827 }
828
829 f->a1 = a1;
830}
831
832void tPoleZero_setCoefficients (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat b0, Lfloat b1, Lfloat a1)
833{
834 if (a1 >= 1.0f) // a1 should be less than 1.0
835 {
836 a1 = 0.999999f;
837 }
838
839 f->b0 = b0;
840 f->b1 = b1;
841 f->a1 = a1;
842}
843
844void tPoleZero_setThiranAllpassSOCascade (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat coeff)
845{
846 if (coeff >= 1.0f) // allpass coefficient >= 1.0 makes filter unstable
847 {
848 coeff = 0.999999f;
849 }
850
851 f->b0 = coeff;
852 f->b1 = 1.0f;
853 f->a1 = coeff;
854}
855
856void tPoleZero_setBlockZero (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat thePole)
857{
858 if (thePole >= 1.0f) // allpass coefficient >= 1.0 makes filter unstable
859 {
860 thePole = 0.999999f;
861 }
862
863 f->b0 = 1.0f;
864 f->b1 = -1.0f;
865 f->a1 = -thePole;
866}
867
868void tPoleZero_setGain (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat gain)
869{
870 f->gain = gain;
871}
872
873Lfloat tPoleZero_tick (tPoleZero const f, Lfloat input)
874{
875 Lfloat in = input * f->gain;
876 Lfloat out = (f->b0 * in) + (f->b1 * f->lastIn) - (f->a1 * f->lastOut);
877
878 f->lastIn = in;
879 f->lastOut = out;
880
881 return out;
882}

884/******************************************************************************/
885/* BiQuad Filter */
886/******************************************************************************/
887
888
889void tBiQuad_init (tBiQuad *const ft, LEAF *const leaf)
890{
891 tBiQuad_initToPool(ft, &leaf->mempool);
892}
893
894void tBiQuad_initToPool (tBiQuad *const ft, tMempool *const mp)
895{
896 _tMempool *m = *mp;
897 _tBiQuad *f = *ft = (_tBiQuad *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tBiQuad), m);
898 f->mempool = m;
899 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
900
901 f->gain = 1.0f;
902
903 f->b0 = 0.0f;
904 f->a0 = 0.0f;
905
906 f->lastIn[0] = 0.0f;
907 f->lastIn[1] = 0.0f;
908 f->lastOut[0] = 0.0f;
909 f->lastOut[1] = 0.0f;
910
911 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = leaf->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
912}
913
914void tBiQuad_free (tBiQuad *const ft)
915{
916 _tBiQuad *f = *ft;
917 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
918}
919
920Lfloat tBiQuad_tick (tBiQuad const f, Lfloat input)
921{
922 Lfloat in = input * f->gain;
923 Lfloat out = f->b0 * in + f->b1 * f->lastIn[0] + f->b2 * f->lastIn[1];
924 out -= f->a2 * f->lastOut[1] + f->a1 * f->lastOut[0];
925
926 f->lastIn[1] = f->lastIn[0];
927 f->lastIn[0] = in;
928
929 f->lastOut[1] = f->lastOut[0];
930 f->lastOut[0] = out;
931
932 return out;
933}
934
935void tBiQuad_setResonance (tBiQuad const f, Lfloat freq, Lfloat radius, int normalize)
936{
937 if (freq < 0.0f) freq = 0.0f;
938 if (freq > (f->sampleRate * 0.49f))
939 freq = f->sampleRate * 0.49f;
940 if (radius < 0.0f) radius = 0.0f;
941 if (radius >= 1.0f) radius = 1.0f;
942
943 f->frequency = freq;
944 f->radius = radius;
945 f->normalize = normalize;
946
947 f->a2 = radius * radius;
948 f->a1 = -2.0f * radius * cosf(freq * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
949
950 if (normalize) {
951 f->b0 = 0.5f - 0.5f * f->a2;
952 f->b1 = 0.0f;
953 f->b2 = -f->b0;
954 }
955}
956
957void tBiQuad_setNotch (tBiQuad const f, Lfloat freq, Lfloat radius)
958{
959 if (freq < 0.0f) freq = 0.0f;
960 if (freq > (f->sampleRate * 0.49f))
961 freq = f->sampleRate * 0.49f;
962 if (radius < 0.0f) radius = 0.0f;
963
964 f->b2 = radius * radius;
965 f->b1 = -2.0f * radius * cosf(freq * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate); // OPTIMIZE with LOOKUP or APPROXIMATION
966
967 // Does not attempt to normalize filter gain.
968}
969
970void tBiQuad_setEqualGainZeros (tBiQuad *const ft)
971{
972 _tBiQuad *f = *ft;
973 f->b0 = 1.0f;
974 f->b1 = 0.0f;
975 f->b2 = -1.0f;

984{
985 f->b1 = b1;
986}

988void tBiQuad_setB2 (tBiQuad const f, Lfloat b2)

990 f->b2 = b2;

994{

998void tBiQuad_setA2 (tBiQuad const f, Lfloat a2)
999{
1000 f->a2 = a2;

1003void tBiQuad_setCoefficients (tBiQuad const f, Lfloat b0, Lfloat b1, Lfloat b2,
1004 Lfloat a1, Lfloat a2)
1005{
1006 f->b0 = b0;
1007 f->b1 = b1;
1008 f->b2 = b2;
1009 f->a1 = a1;
1010 f->a2 = a2;

1015 f->gain = gain;

1018void tBiQuad_setSampleRate (tBiQuad const f, Lfloat sr)
1019{
1020 f->sampleRate = sr;
1021 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = TWO_PI * (1.0f / f->sampleRate);
1022
1023 f->a2 = f->radius * f->radius;
1024 f->a1 = -2.0f * f->radius * cosf(f->frequency * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
1025
1026 if (f->normalize) {

1034/******************************************************************************/
1035/* SVF Filter */
1036/******************************************************************************/
1037
1038
1039// Less efficient, more accurate version of SVF, in which cutoff frequency is
1040// taken as Lfloating point Hz value and tanf is calculated when frequency changes.
1041void tSVF_init (tSVF *const svff, SVFType type, Lfloat freq, Lfloat Q,
1042 LEAF *const leaf)
1043{
1044 tSVF_initToPool(svff, type, freq, Q, &leaf->mempool);
1045 // or maybe this?
1046 /*
1047 * hp=1 bp=A/Q (where A is 10^(G/40) and G is gain in decibels) and lp = 1
1048 */
1049}
1050
1051void tSVF_initToPool (tSVF *const svff, SVFType type, Lfloat freq, Lfloat Q,
1052 tMempool *const mp)
1053{
1054 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1055 _tSVF *svf = *svff = (_tSVF *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tSVF), m);
1056 svf->mempool = m;
1057
1058 LEAF *leaf = svf->mempool->leaf;
1059
1060 svf->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
1061 svf->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
1062 svf->sampleRatio = 48000.0f / svf->sampleRate;
1063 svf->type = type;
1064
1065 svf->ic1eq = 0.0f;
1066 svf->ic2eq = 0.0f;
1067 svf->Q = Q;
1068 svf->cutoff = freq;
1069 svf->g = tanf(PI * freq * svf->invSampleRate);
1070 svf->k = 1.0f / Q;
1071 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1072 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1073 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1074
1075 svf->cH = 0.0f;
1076 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1077 svf->cBK = 0.0f;
1078 svf->cL = 1.0f;
1079
1080 if (type == SVFTypeLowpass) {
1081 svf->cH = 0.0f;
1082 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1083 svf->cBK = 0.0f;
1084 svf->cL = 1.0f;
1085 } else if (type == SVFTypeBandpass) {
1086 svf->cH = 0.0f;
1087 svf->cB = 1.0f;
1088 svf->cBK = 0.0f;
1089 svf->cL = 0.0f;
1090 } else if (type == SVFTypeHighpass) {
1091 svf->cH = 1.0f;
1092 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1093 svf->cBK = -1.0f;
1094 svf->cL = -1.0f;
1095 } else if (type == SVFTypeNotch) {
1096 svf->cH = 1.0f;
1097 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1098 svf->cBK = -1.0f;
1099 svf->cL = 0.0f;
1100 } else if (type == SVFTypePeak) {
1101 svf->cH = 1.0f;
1102 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1103 svf->cBK = -1.0f;
1104 svf->cL = -2.0f;
1105 }
1106 if (leaf->sampleRate > 90000) {
1107 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
1108 } else {
1109 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
1110 }
1111}
1112
1113void tSVF_free (tSVF *const svff)
1114{
1115 _tSVF *svf = *svff;
1116 mpool_free((char *) svf, svf->mempool);
1117}
1118
1119Lfloat tSVF_tick (tSVF const svf, Lfloat v0)
1120{
1121 Lfloat v1, v2, v3;
1122 v3 = v0 - svf->ic2eq;
1123 v1 = (svf->a1 * svf->ic1eq) + (svf->a2 * v3);
1124 v2 = svf->ic2eq + (svf->a2 * svf->ic1eq) + (svf->a3 * v3);
1125 svf->ic1eq = (2.0f * v1) - svf->ic1eq;
1126 svf->ic2eq = (2.0f * v2) - svf->ic2eq;
1127
1128 return (v0 * svf->cH) + (v1 * svf->cB) + (svf->k * v1 * svf->cBK) +
1129 (v2 * svf->cL);
1130}
1131
1132Lfloat tSVF_tickHP (tSVF const svf, Lfloat v0)
1133{
1134 Lfloat v1, v2;
1135 v1 = svf->a1 * svf->ic1eq + svf->a2 * (v0 - svf->ic2eq);
1136 v2 = svf->ic2eq + svf->g * v1;
1137 svf->ic1eq = (2.0f * v1) - svf->ic1eq;
1138 svf->ic2eq = (2.0f * v2) - svf->ic2eq;
1139 return v0 - (svf->k * v1) - (v2);
1140}
1141
1142Lfloat tSVF_tickBP (tSVF const svf, Lfloat v0)
1143{
1144 Lfloat v1, v2;
1145 v1 = svf->a1 * svf->ic1eq + svf->a2 * (v0 - svf->ic2eq);
1146 v2 = svf->ic2eq + svf->g * v1;
1147 svf->ic1eq = (2.0f * v1) - svf->ic1eq;
1148 svf->ic2eq = (2.0f * v2) - svf->ic2eq;
1149
1150 return v1;
1151}
1152
1153Lfloat tSVF_tickLP (tSVF const svf, Lfloat v0)
1154{
1155 Lfloat v1, v2;
1156 v1 = svf->a1 * svf->ic1eq + svf->a2 * (v0 - svf->ic2eq);
1157 v2 = svf->ic2eq + svf->g * v1;
1158 svf->ic1eq = (2.0f * v1) - svf->ic1eq;
1159 svf->ic2eq = (2.0f * v2) - svf->ic2eq;
1160 return v2;
1161}
1162
1163void tSVF_setFreq (tSVF const svf, Lfloat freq)
1164{
1165 svf->cutoff = LEAF_clip(0.0f, freq, svf->sampleRate * 0.5f);
1166 svf->g = tanf(PI * svf->cutoff * svf->invSampleRate);
1167 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1168 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1169 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1170}
1171
1172void tSVF_setFreqFast (tSVF const svf, Lfloat cutoff)
1173{
1174 svf->cutoffMIDI = cutoff;
1175 cutoff *= 30.567164179104478f; //get 0-134 midi range to 0-4095
1176 int32_t intVer = (int32_t) cutoff;
1177 if (intVer > 4094) {
1178 intVer = 4094;
1179 }
1180 if (intVer < 0) {
1181 intVer = 0;
1182 }
1183 Lfloat LfloatVer = cutoff - (Lfloat) intVer;
1184
1185 svf->g = ((svf->table[intVer] * (1.0f - LfloatVer)) +
1186 (svf->table[intVer + 1] * LfloatVer)) * svf->sampleRatio;
1187 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1188 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1189 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1190}
1191
1192void tSVF_setQ (tSVF const svf, Lfloat Q)
1193{
1194 svf->Q = Q;
1195 svf->k = 1.0f / Q;
1196
1197 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1198 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1199 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1200}
1201
1202void tSVF_setFreqAndQ (tSVF const svf, Lfloat freq, Lfloat Q)
1203{
1204 svf->cutoff = LEAF_clip(0.0f, freq, svf->sampleRate * 0.5f);
1205 svf->k = 1.0f / Q;
1206 svf->g = tanf(PI * svf->cutoff * svf->invSampleRate);
1207 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1208 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1209 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1210}
1211
1212void tSVF_setFreqAndQFast (tSVF const svf, Lfloat cutoff, Lfloat Q)
1213{
1214 svf->cutoffMIDI = cutoff;
1215 cutoff *= 30.567164179104478f; //get 0-134 midi range to 0-4095
1216 int32_t intVer = (int32_t) cutoff;
1217 if (intVer > 4094) {
1218 intVer = 4094;
1219 }
1220 if (intVer < 0) {
1221 intVer = 0;
1222 }
1223 Lfloat LfloatVer = cutoff - (Lfloat) intVer;
1224 svf->Q = Q;
1225 svf->k = 1.0f / Q;
1226 svf->g = ((svf->table[intVer] * (1.0f - LfloatVer)) + (svf->table[intVer + 1] * LfloatVer)) * svf->sampleRatio;
1227 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1228 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1229 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1230}
1231
1232void tSVF_setFilterType (tSVF const svf, SVFType type)
1233{
1234 if (type == SVFTypeLowpass) {
1235 svf->cH = 0.0f;
1236 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1237 svf->cBK = 0.0f;
1238 svf->cL = 1.0f;
1239 } else if (type == SVFTypeBandpass) {
1240 svf->cH = 0.0f;
1241 svf->cB = 1.0f;
1242 svf->cBK = 0.0f;
1243 svf->cL = 0.0f;
1244 } else if (type == SVFTypeHighpass) {
1245 svf->cH = 1.0f;
1246 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1247 svf->cBK = -1.0f;
1248 svf->cL = -1.0f;
1249 } else if (type == SVFTypeNotch) {
1250 svf->cH = 1.0f;
1251 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1252 svf->cBK = -1.0f;
1253 svf->cL = 0.0f;
1254 } else if (type == SVFTypePeak) {
1255 svf->cH = 1.0f;
1256 svf->cB = 0.0f;
1257 svf->cBK = -1.0f;
1258 svf->cL = -2.0f;
1259 }
1260}
1261
1262void tSVF_setSampleRate (tSVF const svf, Lfloat sr)
1263{
1264 svf->sampleRate = sr;
1265 svf->invSampleRate = 1.0f / svf->sampleRate;
1266 svf->sampleRatio = 48000.0f / svf->sampleRate;
1267 if (sr > 80000) {
1268 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
1269 } else {
1270 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
1271 }
1272}
1273
1274//only works for lowpass right now
1275//actually doesn't work at all yet!
1276Lfloat tSVF_getPhaseAtFrequency (tSVF const svf, Lfloat freq)
1277{
1278 Lfloat w = svf->invSampleRate * freq * TWO_PI;
1279 Lfloat c = 0.0f;
1280 Lfloat f = 0.0f;
1281 Lfloat d = 0.0f;
1282 Lfloat num = sinf(2.0f * w) * (c - f);
1283 Lfloat den = (c + f) + (2.0f * d * cosf(w)) + ((c + f) * cosf(2.0f * w));
1284 return atan2f(num, den);
1285}

1300void tSVF_LP_initToPool (tSVF_LP *const svff, Lfloat freq, Lfloat Q, tMempool *const mp)
1301{
1302 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1303 _tSVF_LP *svf = *svff = (_tSVF_LP *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tSVF_LP), m);
1304 svf->mempool = m;
1305
1306 LEAF *leaf = svf->mempool->leaf;
1307
1308 svf->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
1309 svf->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
1310 svf->sampleRatio = svf->sampleRate / 48000.0f;
1311
1312 svf->ic1eq = 0.0f;
1313 svf->ic2eq = 0.0f;
1314 svf->g = tanf(PI * freq * svf->invSampleRate);
1315 if (Q > 0.99f) {
1316 Q = 0.99f;
1317 }
1318 svf->k = 2.0f * Q;
1319 svf->onePlusg = 1.0f + svf->g;
1320 svf->a0 = 1.0f / ((svf->onePlusg * svf->onePlusg) - (svf->g * svf->k));
1321 svf->a1 = svf->k * svf->a0;
1322 svf->a2 = svf->onePlusg * svf->a0;
1323 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1324 svf->a4 = 1.0f / svf->onePlusg;
1325 svf->a5 = svf->g * svf->a4;
1326 svf->nan = 0;
1327
1328 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {
1329 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
1330 } else {
1331 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
1332 }
1333}
1334
1335void tSVF_LP_free (tSVF_LP* const svff)
1336{
1337 _tSVF_LP *svf = *svff;
1338 mpool_free((char *) svf, svf->mempool);
1339}
1340
1341Lfloat tSVF_LP_tick (tSVF_LP const svf, Lfloat v0)
1342{
1343 Lfloat v1, v2;
1344 v1 = svf->a1 * svf->ic2eq + svf->a2 * svf->ic1eq + svf->a3 * v0;
1345 v2 = svf->a4 * svf->ic2eq + svf->a5 * v1;
1346 svf->ic1eq = (2.0f * (v1 - svf->k * v2)) - svf->ic1eq;
1347 svf->ic2eq = (2.0f * v2) - svf->ic2eq;
1348 return v2;
1349}

1352{

1354 svf->g = tanf(PI * cutoff * svf->invSampleRate);
1355 svf->onePlusg = 1.0f + svf->g;
1356 svf->a0 = 1.0f / ((svf->onePlusg * svf->onePlusg) - (svf->g * svf->k));
1357 svf->a1 = svf->k * svf->a0;
1358 svf->a2 = svf->onePlusg * svf->a0;
1359 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1360 svf->a4 = 1.0f / svf->onePlusg;
1361 svf->a5 = svf->g * svf->a4;
1362
1363
1364}

1459//only works for lowpass right now
1460//actually doesn't work at all yet!
1461Lfloat tSVF_LP_getPhaseAtFrequency (tSVF_LP const svf, Lfloat freq)
1462{
1463 Lfloat w = svf->invSampleRate * freq * TWO_PI;
1464 Lfloat c = 0.0f;
1465 Lfloat f = 0.0f;
1466 Lfloat d = 0.0f;
1467 Lfloat num = sinf(2.0f * w) * (c - f);
1468 Lfloat den = (c + f) + (2.0f * d * cosf(w)) + ((c + f) * cosf(2.0f * w));
1469 return atan2f(num, den);
1470}

1475/******************************************************************************/
1476/* SVF Filter (Efficient) */
1477/******************************************************************************/
1478
1479
1480// Efficient version of tSVF where frequency is set based on 12-bit integer input for lookup in tanh wavetable.
1481void tEfficientSVF_init(tEfficientSVF *const svff, SVFType type, uint16_t input, Lfloat Q, LEAF *const leaf) {
1482 tEfficientSVF_initToPool(svff, type, input, Q, &leaf->mempool);
1483}
1484
1485void tEfficientSVF_initToPool (tEfficientSVF *const svff, SVFType type,
1486 uint16_t input, Lfloat Q, tMempool *const mp)
1487{
1488 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1489 _tEfficientSVF *svf = *svff = (_tEfficientSVF *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tEfficientSVF), m);
1490 svf->mempool = m;
1491
1492 svf->type = type;
1493
1494 svf->ic1eq = 0.0f;
1495 svf->ic2eq = 0.0f;
1496 LEAF *leaf = svf->mempool->leaf;
1497 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {
1498 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
1499 } else {
1500 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
1501 }
1502
1503 svf->g = svf->table[input];
1504 svf->k = 1.0f / Q;
1505 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1506 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1507 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1508}
1509
1510void tEfficientSVF_free (tEfficientSVF *const svff)
1511{
1512 _tEfficientSVF *svf = *svff;
1513 mpool_free((char *) svf, svf->mempool);
1514}
1515
1516Lfloat tEfficientSVF_tick (tEfficientSVF const svf, Lfloat v0)
1517{
1518 Lfloat v1, v2, v3;
1519 v3 = v0 - svf->ic2eq;
1520 v1 = (svf->a1 * svf->ic1eq) + (svf->a2 * v3);
1521 v2 = svf->ic2eq + (svf->a2 * svf->ic1eq) + (svf->a3 * v3);
1522 svf->ic1eq = (2.0f * v1) - svf->ic1eq;
1523 svf->ic2eq = (2.0f * v2) - svf->ic2eq;
1524
1525 if (svf->type == SVFTypeLowpass) return v2;
1526 else if (svf->type == SVFTypeBandpass) return v1;
1527 else if (svf->type == SVFTypeHighpass) return v0 - (svf->k * v1) - v2;
1528 else if (svf->type == SVFTypeNotch) return v0 - (svf->k * v1);
1529 else if (svf->type == SVFTypePeak) return v0 - (svf->k * v1) - (2.0f * v2);
1530 else return 0.0f;
1531
1532}
1533
1534void tEfficientSVF_setFreq (tEfficientSVF const svf, Lfloat cutoff)
1535{
1536 cutoff *= 30.567164179104478f;
1537 int32_t intVer = (int32_t) cutoff;
1538 if (intVer > 4094) {
1539 intVer = 4094;
1540 }
1541 if (intVer < 0) {
1542 intVer = 0;
1543 }
1544 svf->g = svf->table[intVer];
1545 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1546 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1547 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1548}
1549
1550void tEfficientSVF_setQ (tEfficientSVF const svf, Lfloat Q)
1551{
1552 svf->k = 1.0f / Q;
1553 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1554 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1555 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1556}
1557
1558void tEfficientSVF_setFreqAndQ (tEfficientSVF const svf, uint16_t input, Lfloat Q)
1559{
1560 svf->g = svf->table[input];
1561 svf->k = 1.0f / Q;
1562 svf->a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + svf->g * (svf->g + svf->k));
1563 svf->a2 = svf->g * svf->a1;
1564 svf->a3 = svf->g * svf->a2;
1565}
1566
1567void tEfficientSVF_setSampleRate (tEfficientSVF const svf, Lfloat sampleRate)
1568{
1569 if (sampleRate > 80000) {
1570 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
1571 } else {
1572 svf->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
1573 }
1574}

1579/******************************************************************************/
1580/* Highpass Filter */
1581/******************************************************************************/
1582
1583
1584void tHighpass_init (tHighpass *const ft, Lfloat freq, LEAF *const leaf)
1585{
1586 tHighpass_initToPool(ft, freq, &leaf->mempool);
1587}
1588
1589void tHighpass_initToPool (tHighpass *const ft, Lfloat freq, tMempool *const mp)
1590{
1591 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1592 _tHighpass *f = *ft = (_tHighpass *) mpool_calloc(sizeof(_tHighpass), m);
1593 f->mempool = m;
1594 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
1595
1596 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = leaf->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
1597 f->R = (1.0f - (freq * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate));
1598 f->ys = 0.0f;
1599 f->xs = 0.0f;
1600
1601 f->frequency = freq;
1602}
1603
1604void tHighpass_free (tHighpass *const ft)
1605{
1606 _tHighpass *f = *ft;
1607 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
1608}
1609
1610void tHighpass_setFreq (tHighpass const f, Lfloat freq)
1611{
1612 f->frequency = freq;
1613 f->R = (1.0f - (freq * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate));
1614}
1615
1616Lfloat tHighpass_getFreq (tHighpass const f)
1617{
1618 return f->frequency;
1619}
1620
1621// From JOS DC Blocker
1622Lfloat tHighpass_tick (tHighpass const f, Lfloat x)
1623{
1624 f->ys = x - f->xs + f->R * f->ys;
1625 f->xs = x;
1626 return f->ys;
1627}
1628
1629void tHighpass_setSampleRate (tHighpass const f, Lfloat sr)
1630{
1631 f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = TWO_PI * (1.0f / sr);
1632 f->R = (1.0f - (f->frequency * f->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate));
1633}

1636/******************************************************************************/
1637/* Butterworth Filter */
1638/******************************************************************************/
1639
1640
1641void tButterworth_init (tButterworth *const ft, int order, Lfloat f1, Lfloat f2,
1642 LEAF *const leaf)
1643{
1644 tButterworth_initToPool(ft, order, f1, f2, &leaf->mempool);
1645}
1646
1647void tButterworth_initToPool (tButterworth *const ft, int order, Lfloat f1,
1648 Lfloat f2, tMempool *const mp)
1649{
1650 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1651 _tButterworth *f = *ft = (_tButterworth *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tButterworth), m);
1652 f->mempool = m;
1653
1654 f->f1 = f1;
1655 f->f2 = f2;
1656 f->gain = 1.0f;
1657
1658 f->numSVF = f->order = order;
1659 if (f1 >= 0.0f && f2 >= 0.0f) f->numSVF *= 2;
1660
1661 f->svf = (tSVF *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(tSVF) * f->numSVF, m);
1662
1663 int o = 0;
1664 if (f1 >= 0.0f) o = f->order;
1665 for (int i = 0; i < f->order; ++i) {
1666 if (f1 >= 0.0f)
1667 tSVF_initToPool(&f->svf[i], SVFTypeHighpass, f1, 0.5f / cosf((1.0f + 2.0f * i) * PI / (4 * f->order)), mp);
1668 if (f2 >= 0.0f)
1669 tSVF_initToPool(&f->svf[i + o], SVFTypeLowpass, f2, 0.5f / cosf((1.0f + 2.0f * i) * PI / (4 * f->order)),
1670 mp);
1671 }
1672}
1673
1674void tButterworth_free (tButterworth *const ft)
1675{
1676 _tButterworth *f = *ft;
1677
1678 for (int i = 0; i < f->numSVF; ++i) tSVF_free(&f->svf[i]);
1679
1680 mpool_free((char *) f->svf, f->mempool);
1681 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
1682}
1683
1684Lfloat tButterworth_tick (tButterworth const f, Lfloat samp)
1685{
1686 for (int i = 0; i < f->numSVF; ++i)
1687 samp = tSVF_tick(f->svf[i], samp);
1688
1689 return samp;
1690}
1691
1692void tButterworth_setF1 (tButterworth const f, Lfloat f1)
1693{
1694 if (f->f1 < 0.0f || f1 < 0.0f) return;
1695
1696 f->f1 = f1;
1697 for (int i = 0; i < f->order; ++i) tSVF_setFreq(f->svf[i], f1);
1698}
1699
1700void tButterworth_setF2 (tButterworth const f, Lfloat f2)
1701{
1702 if (f->f2 < 0.0f || f2 < 0.0f) return;
1703
1704 int o = 0;
1705 if (f->f1 >= 0.0f) o = f->order;
1706 f->f2 = f2;
1707 for (int i = 0; i < f->order; ++i) tSVF_setFreq(f->svf[i + o], f2);
1708}
1709
1710void tButterworth_setFreqs (tButterworth const f, Lfloat f1, Lfloat f2)
1711{
1712 tButterworth_setF1(f, f1);
1713 tButterworth_setF2(f, f2);
1714}
1715
1716void tButterworth_setSampleRate (tButterworth const f, Lfloat sr)
1717{
1718 for (int i = 0; i < f->numSVF; ++i) tSVF_setSampleRate(f->svf[i], sr);
1719}

1722/******************************************************************************/
1723/* FIR Filter */
1724/******************************************************************************/
1725
1726
1727void tFIR_init (tFIR *const firf, Lfloat *coeffs, int numTaps, LEAF *const leaf)
1728{
1729 tFIR_initToPool(firf, coeffs, numTaps, &leaf->mempool);
1730}
1731
1732void tFIR_initToPool (tFIR *const firf, Lfloat *coeffs, int numTaps, tMempool *const mp)
1733{
1734 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1735 _tFIR *fir = *firf = (_tFIR *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tFIR), m);
1736 fir->mempool = m;
1737
1738 fir->numTaps = numTaps;
1739 fir->coeff = coeffs;
1740 fir->past = (Lfloat *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat) * fir->numTaps, m);
1741 for (int i = 0; i < fir->numTaps; ++i) fir->past[i] = 0.0f;
1742}
1743
1744void tFIR_free (tFIR *const firf)
1745{
1746 _tFIR *fir = *firf;
1747
1748 mpool_free((char *) fir->past, fir->mempool);
1749 mpool_free((char *) fir, fir->mempool);
1750}
1751
1752Lfloat tFIR_tick (tFIR const fir, Lfloat input)
1753{
1754 fir->past[0] = input;
1755 Lfloat y = 0.0f;
1756 for (int i = 0; i < fir->numTaps; ++i) y += fir->past[i] * fir->coeff[i];
1757 for (int i = fir->numTaps - 1; i > 0; --i) fir->past[i] = fir->past[i - 1];
1758 return y;
1759}

1762/******************************************************************************/
1763/* Median Filter */
1764/******************************************************************************/
1765
1766
1767//---------------------------------------------
1771
1772
1773void tMedianFilter_init (tMedianFilter *const f, int size, LEAF *const leaf)
1774{
1775 tMedianFilter_initToPool(f, size, &leaf->mempool);
1776}
1777
1778void tMedianFilter_initToPool (tMedianFilter *const mf, int size, tMempool *const mp)
1779{
1780 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1781 _tMedianFilter *f = *mf = (_tMedianFilter *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tMedianFilter), m);
1782 f->mempool = m;
1783
1784 f->size = size;
1785 f->middlePosition = size / 2;
1786 f->last = size - 1;
1787 f->pos = -1;
1788 f->val = (Lfloat *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat) * size, m);
1789 f->age = (int *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(int) * size, m);
1790 for (int i = 0; i < f->size; ++i) {
1791 f->val[i] = 0.0f;
1792 f->age[i] = i;
1793 }
1794
1795}
1796
1797void tMedianFilter_free (tMedianFilter *const mf)
1798{
1799 _tMedianFilter *f = *mf;
1800
1801 mpool_free((char *) f->val, f->mempool);
1802 mpool_free((char *) f->age, f->mempool);
1803 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
1804}
1805
1806Lfloat tMedianFilter_tick (tMedianFilter const f, Lfloat input)
1807{
1808 for (int i = 0; i < f->size; i++) {
1809 int thisAge = f->age[i];
1810 if (thisAge == f->last) {
1811 f->pos = i;
1812 } else {
1813 thisAge++;
1814 f->age[i] = thisAge;
1815 }
1816 }
1817
1818 while (f->pos != 0) {
1819 Lfloat test = f->val[f->pos - 1];
1820 if (input < test) {
1821 f->val[f->pos] = test;
1822 f->age[f->pos] = f->age[f->pos - 1];
1823 f->pos -= 1;
1824 } else { break; }
1825 }
1826
1827 while (f->pos != f->last) {
1828 Lfloat test = f->val[f->pos + 1];
1829 if (input > test) {
1830 f->val[f->pos] = test;
1831 f->age[f->pos] = f->age[f->pos + 1];
1832 f->pos += 1;
1833 } else { break; }
1834 }
1835
1836 f->val[f->pos] = input;
1837 f->age[f->pos] = 0;
1838
1839 return f->val[f->middlePosition];
1840}

1853
1854void tVZFilter_initToPool (tVZFilter *const vf, VZFilterType type, Lfloat freq,
1855 Lfloat bandWidth, tMempool *const mp)
1856{
1857 _tMempool *m = *mp;
1858 _tVZFilter *f = *vf = (_tVZFilter *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tVZFilter), m);
1859 f->mempool = m;
1860
1861 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
1862
1863 f->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
1864 f->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
1865 f->sampRatio = 48000.0f / f->sampleRate;
1866 f->fc = LEAF_clip(0.0f, freq, 0.5f * f->sampleRate);
1867 f->cutoffMIDI = ftom(f->fc);
1868 f->type = type;
1869 f->G = INV_SQRT2;
1870
1871 f->invG = 1.414213562373095f;
1872 f->B = bandWidth;
1873 f->m = 0.0f;
1874 f->Q = 0.5f;
1875 f->s1 = 0.0f;
1876 f->s2 = 0.0f;
1877 f->R2 = f->invG;
1878 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
1879 f->g = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11)
1880 tVZFilter_setBandwidth(*vf, f->B);
1881 tVZFilter_calcCoeffs(*vf);
1882 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {
1883 f->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
1884 } else {
1885 f->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
1886 }
1887}

1889void tVZFilter_free (tVZFilter *const vf)
1890{
1891 _tVZFilter *f = *vf;
1892 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
1893}
1894
1895Lfloat tVZFilter_tick (tVZFilter const f, Lfloat in)
1896{
1897 Lfloat yL, yB, yH, v1, v2;
1898
1899 // compute highpass output via Eq. 5.1:
1900 //yH = (in - f->R2*f->s1 - f->g*f->s1 - f->s2) * f->h;
1901 yH = (in - (f->R2Plusg * f->s1) - f->s2) * f->h;
1902 // compute bandpass output by applying 1st integrator to highpass output:
1903 v1 = f->g * yH;
1904 yB = tanhf(v1) + f->s1;
1905 f->s1 = v1 + yB; // state update in 1st integrator
1906
1907 // compute lowpass output by applying 2nd integrator to bandpass output:
1908 v2 = f->g * yB;
1909 yL = tanhf(v2) + f->s2;
1910 f->s2 = v2 + yL; // state update in 2nd integrator
1911
1912 //according to the Vadim paper, we could add saturation to this model by adding a tanh in the integration stage.
1913 //
1914 //seems like that might look like this:
1915 // y = tanh(g*x) + s; // output computation
1916 // s = g*x + y; // state update
1917
1918 //instead of this:
1919 // y = g*x + s; // output computation
1920 // s = g*x + y; // state update
1921
1922 // if we wanted to go into self-oscillation with stabiity we would need to use an anti-saturator on the feedback loop, haven't figured that out yet. -JS
1923
1924 return f->cL * yL + f->cB * yB + f->cH * yH;
1925}
1926
1927Lfloat tVZFilter_tickEfficient (tVZFilter const f, Lfloat in)
1928{
1929 Lfloat yL, yB, yH, v1, v2;
1930
1931 // compute highpass output via Eq. 5.1:
1932 //yH = (in - f->R2*f->s1 - f->g*f->s1 - f->s2) * f->h;
1933 yH = (in - (f->R2Plusg * f->s1) - f->s2) * f->h;
1934 // compute bandpass output by applying 1st integrator to highpass output:
1935 v1 = f->g * yH;
1936 yB = v1 + f->s1;
1937 f->s1 = v1 + yB; // state update in 1st integrator
1938
1939 // compute lowpass output by applying 2nd integrator to bandpass output:
1940 v2 = f->g * yB;
1941 yL = v2 + f->s2;
1942 f->s2 = v2 + yL; // state update in 2nd integrator
1943
1944 return f->cL * yL + f->cB * yB + f->cH * yH;
1945}
1946
1947void tVZFilter_calcCoeffs (tVZFilter const f)
1948{
1949 f->g = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11)
1950
1951 switch (f->type) {
1952 case Bypass: {
1953 f->R2 = f->invG;
1954 f->cL = 1.0f;
1955 f->cB = f->R2;
1956 f->cH = 1.0f;
1957
1958 }
1959 break;
1960 case Lowpass: {
1961 //f->R2 = f->invG;
1962 //f->g = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11)
1963 f->cL = 1.0f;
1964 f->cB = 0.0f;
1965 f->cH = 0.0f;
1966
1967 }
1968 break;
1969 case Highpass: {
1970 //f->g = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11)
1971 //f->R2 = f->invG;
1972 f->cL = 0.0f;
1973 f->cB = 0.0f;
1974 f->cH = 1.0f;
1975 }
1976 break;
1977 case BandpassSkirt: {
1978 //f->g = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11)
1979 //f->R2 = f->invG;
1980 f->cL = 0.0f;
1981 f->cB = 1.0f;
1982 f->cH = 0.0f;
1983 }
1984 break;
1985 case BandpassPeak: {
1986 //f->R2 = 2.0f*tVZFilter_BandwidthToR(vf, f->B);
1987 //f->g = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11)
1988 f->cL = 0.0f;
1989 f->cB = f->G * f->R2;
1990 f->cH = 0.0f;
1991 //f->cL = 0.0f; f->cB = f->R2; f->cH = 0.0f;
1992 }
1993 break;
1994 case BandReject: {
1995 //f->R2 = 2.0f*tVZFilter_BandwidthToR(vf, f->B);
1996 //f->g = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11)
1997 f->cL = 1.0f;
1998 f->cB = 0.0f;
1999 f->cH = 1.0f;
2000 }
2001 break;
2002 case Bell: {
2003 Lfloat fl = f->fc * powf(2.0f, (-f->B) * 0.5f); // lower bandedge frequency (in Hz)
2004 Lfloat wl = tanf(PI * fl * f->invSampleRate); // warped radian lower bandedge frequency /(2*fs)
2005 Lfloat r = f->g / wl;
2006 r *= r; // warped frequency ratio wu/wl == (wc/wl)^2 where wu is the
2007 // warped upper bandedge, wc the center
2008 f->R2 = 2.0f * sqrtf(((r * r + 1.0f) / r - 2.0f) / (4.0f * f->G));
2009 f->cL = 1.0f;
2010 f->cB = f->R2 * f->G;
2011 f->cH = 1.0f;
2012 }
2013 break;
2014 case Lowshelf: {
2015 Lfloat A = sqrtf(f->G);
2016 f->g /= sqrtf(A); // scale SVF-cutoff frequency for shelvers
2017 //f->R2 = 2*sinhf(f->B*logf(2.0f)*0.5f); if using bandwidth instead of Q
2018 //f->R2 = f->invQ;
2019 f->cL = f->G;
2020 f->cB = f->R2 * f->G;
2021 f->cH = 1.0f;
2022
2023 }
2024 break;
2025 case Highshelf: {
2026 Lfloat A = sqrtf(f->G);
2027 f->g *= sqrtf(A); // scale SVF-cutoff frequency for shelvers
2028 //f->R2 = 2.0f*sinhf(f->B*logf(2.0f)*0.5f); if using bandwidth instead of Q
2029 f->cL = 1.0f;
2030 f->cB = f->R2 * f->G;
2031 f->cH = f->G;
2032 }
2033 break;
2034 case Allpass: {
2035 //f->R2 = 2.0f*tVZFilter_BandwidthToR(vf, f->B); if using bandwidth instead of Q
2036 f->cL = 1.0f;
2037 f->cB = -f->R2;
2038 f->cH = 1.0f;
2039 }
2040 break;
2041
2042 // experimental - maybe we must find better curves for cL, cB, cH:
2043 case Morph: {
2044 //f->R2 = 2.0f*tVZFilter_BandwidthToREfficientBP(vf, f->B);
2045
2046 //f->R2 = f->invG;
2047 //Lfloat x = f->m-1.0f;
2048
2049 Lfloat x = (2.0f * f->m - 1.0f);
2050 //f->cL = maximum(0.0f,(1.0f - (f->m * 2.0f)));
2051 //f->cH = maximum(0.0f,(f->m * 2.0f) - 1.0f);
2052 //f->cB = maximum(0.0f, 1.0f - f->cH - f->cL);
2053 //f->cL = minimum(0.0f,(1.0f - (f->m * 2.0f))) ;
2054 f->cL = maximum(-x, 0.0f); /*cL *= cL;*/
2055 f->cH = minimum(x, 0.0f); /*cH *= cH;*/
2056 f->cB = 1.0f - x * x;
2057
2058 // bottom line: we need to test different versions for how they feel when tweaking the
2059 // morph parameter
2060
2061 // this scaling ensures constant magnitude at the cutoff point (we divide the coefficients by
2062 // the magnitude response value at the cutoff frequency and scale back by the gain):
2063 Lfloat s = f->G * fastsqrtf(
2064 (f->R2 * f->R2) / (f->cL * f->cL + f->cB * f->cB + f->cH * f->cH - 2.0f * f->cL * f->cH)) * 2.0f;
2065 f->cL *= s;
2066 f->cB *= s;
2067 f->cH *= s;
2068 }
2069 break;
2070
2071 }
2072 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2073 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback precomputation
2074}
2075
2076void tVZFilter_calcCoeffsEfficientBP (tVZFilter const f)
2077{
2078 f->g = LEAF_clip(0.001f, fabsf(fastertanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate)),
2079 1000.0f); // embedded integrator gain (Fig 3.11) // added absolute value because g can't be <=0
2080 f->R2 = 2.0f * tVZFilter_BandwidthToREfficientBP(f, f->B); //JS- this will ignore resonance...
2081 f->cB = f->R2;
2082 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + f->R2 * f->g + f->g * f->g); // factor for feedback precomputation
2083}

2085void tVZFilter_setBandwidth (tVZFilter const f, Lfloat B)
2086{
2087 f->B = LEAF_clip(0.0f, B, 100.0f);
2088 f->R2 = 2.0f * tVZFilter_BandwidthToR(f, f->B);
2089 tVZFilter_calcCoeffs(f);

2336Lfloat tVZFilter_BandwidthToR (tVZFilter const f, Lfloat B)
2337{
2338 Lfloat fl = f->fc * powf(2.0f, -B * 0.5f); // lower bandedge frequency (in Hz)
2339 Lfloat gl = tanf(PI * fl * f->invSampleRate); // warped radian lower bandedge frequency /(2*fs)
2340 Lfloat r = gl / f->g; // ratio between warped lower bandedge- and center-frequencies
2341 // unwarped: r = pow(2, -B/2) -> approximation for low
2342 // center-frequencies
2343 return sqrtf((1.0f - r * r) * (1.0f - r * r) / (4.0f * r * r));
2344}
2345
2346Lfloat tVZFilter_BandwidthToREfficientBP (tVZFilter const f, Lfloat B)
2347{
2348 Lfloat fl = f->fc * fastPowf(2.0f, -B * 0.5f); // lower bandedge frequency (in Hz)
2349 Lfloat gl = fastertanf(PI * fl * f->invSampleRate); // warped radian lower bandedge frequency /(2*fs)
2350 Lfloat r = gl / f->g; // ratio between warped lower bandedge- and center-frequencies
2351 // unwarped: r = pow(2, -B/2) -> approximation for low
2352 // center-frequencies
2353 return fastsqrtf((1.0f - r * r) * (1.0f - r * r) / (4.0f * r * r));
2354}

2357{
2358 f->sampleRate = sr;
2359 f->invSampleRate = 1.0f / f->sampleRate;
2360 f->sampRatio = 48000.0f / sr;
2361 if (sr > 80000) {
2362 f->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
2363 } else {
2364 f->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
2365 }
2366}

2373
2374void tVZFilterLS_init (tVZFilterLS *const vf, Lfloat freq, Lfloat Q, Lfloat gain,

2380void tVZFilterLS_initToPool (tVZFilterLS *const vf, Lfloat freq, Lfloat Q,
2381 Lfloat gain, tMempool *const mp)
2382{
2383 _tMempool *m = *mp;
2384 _tVZFilterLS *f = *vf = (_tVZFilterLS *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tVZFilterLS), m);
2385 f->mempool = m;
2386
2387 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
2388
2389 f->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
2390 f->sampRatio = 48000.0f / f->sampleRate;
2391 f->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
2392 f->fc = LEAF_clip(0.0f, freq, 0.5f * f->sampleRate);
2393 f->cutoffMIDI = ftom(f->fc);
2394 f->Q = Q;
2395 f->R2 = 1.0f / Q;
2396 f->s1 = 0.0f;
2397 f->s2 = 0.0f;
2398 f->gPreDiv = tanf(PI * f->fc * f->invSampleRate);
2399 f->G = LEAF_clip(0.000001f, gain, 4000.0f);
2400 f->invSqrtA = 1.0f / (fastsqrtf(fastsqrtf(f->G)));
2401 f->g = f->gPreDiv * f->invSqrtA; // scale SVF-cutoff frequency for shelvers
2402 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2403 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback
2404 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {
2405 f->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
2406 } else {
2407 f->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
2408 }
2409}

2429Lfloat tVZFilterLS_tick (tVZFilterLS const f, Lfloat input)
2430{
2431 Lfloat yL, yB, yH, v1, v2;
2432
2433 // compute highpass output via Eq. 5.1:
2434 //yH = (in - f->R2*f->s1 - f->g*f->s1 - f->s2) * f->h;
2435 yH = (input - (f->R2Plusg * f->s1) - f->s2) * f->h;
2436 // compute bandpass output by applying 1st integrator to highpass output:
2437 v1 = f->g * yH;
2438 yB = v1 + f->s1;
2439 f->s1 = v1 + yB; // state update in 1st integrator
2440
2441 // compute lowpass output by applying 2nd integrator to bandpass output:
2442 v2 = f->g * yB;
2443 yL = v2 + f->s2;
2444 f->s2 = v2 + yL; // state update in 2nd integrator
2445
2446 return f->G * yL + f->R2 * f->G * yB + yH;
2447}

2691/******************************************************************************/
2692/* VZ Bell Filter */
2693/******************************************************************************/
2694
2695
2696void tVZFilterBell_init (tVZFilterBell *const vf, Lfloat freq, Lfloat BW,
2697 Lfloat gain, LEAF *const leaf)
2698{
2699 tVZFilterBell_initToPool(vf, freq, BW, gain, &leaf->mempool);
2700}
2701
2702void tVZFilterBell_initToPool (tVZFilterBell *const vf, Lfloat freq, Lfloat BW,
2703 Lfloat gain, tMempool *const mp)
2704{
2705 _tMempool *m = *mp;
2706 _tVZFilterBell *f = *vf = (_tVZFilterBell *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tVZFilterBell), m);
2707 f->mempool = m;
2708
2709 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
2710
2711 f->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
2712 f->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
2713 f->sampRatio = 48000.0f / f->sampleRate;
2714 f->fc = LEAF_clip(0.0f, freq, 0.5f * f->sampleRate);
2715 f->cutoffMIDI = ftom(f->fc);
2716 f->B = BW;
2717 f->s1 = 0.0f;
2718 f->s2 = 0.0f;
2719 f->G = LEAF_clip(0.000001f, gain, 4000.0f);
2720 f->g = tanf(PI * freq * f->invSampleRate);
2721 Lfloat fl = f->fc * fastPowf(2.0f, (-f->B) * 0.5f); // lower bandedge frequency (in Hz)
2722 Lfloat wl = fastertanf(PI * fl * f->invSampleRate); // warped radian lower bandedge frequency /(2*fs)
2723 Lfloat r = f->g / wl;
2724 r *= r; // warped frequency ratio wu/wl == (wc/wl)^2 where wu is the
2725 // warped upper bandedge, wc the center
2726 f->rToUse = r;
2727 f->R2 = 2.0f * fastsqrtf(((r * r + 1.0f) / r - 2.0f) / (4.0f * f->G));
2728 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2729 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback
2730 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {
2731 f->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
2732 } else {
2733 f->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
2734 }
2735}
2736
2737void tVZFilterBell_free (tVZFilterBell *const vf)
2738{
2739 _tVZFilterBell *f = *vf;
2740 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
2741}

2743void tVZFilterBell_setSampleRate (tVZFilterBell const f, Lfloat sampleRate)
2744{
2745 f->sampleRate = sampleRate;
2746 f->invSampleRate = 1.0f / sampleRate;
2747 f->sampRatio = 48000.0f / f->sampleRate;
2748 if (sampleRate > 80000) {
2749 f->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
2750 } else {
2751 f->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
2752 }
2753}
2754
2755Lfloat tVZFilterBell_tick (tVZFilterBell const f, Lfloat input)
2756{
2757 Lfloat yL, yB, yH, v1, v2;
2758
2759 // compute highpass output via Eq. 5.1:
2760 //yH = (in - f->R2*f->s1 - f->g*f->s1 - f->s2) * f->h;
2761 yH = (input - (f->R2Plusg * f->s1) - f->s2) * f->h;
2762 // compute bandpass output by applying 1st integrator to highpass output:
2763 v1 = f->g * yH;
2764 yB = v1 + f->s1;
2765 f->s1 = v1 + yB; // state update in 1st integrator
2766
2767 // compute lowpass output by applying 2nd integrator to bandpass output:
2768 v2 = f->g * yB;
2769 yL = v2 + f->s2;
2770 f->s2 = v2 + yL; // state update in 2nd integrator
2771
2772 return yL + f->R2 * f->G * yB + yH;
2773}

2874{
2875 f->G = LEAF_clip(0.000001f, gain, 4000.0f);
2876 f->R2 = 2.0f * fastsqrtf(((f->rToUse * f->rToUse + 1.0f) / f->rToUse - 2.0f) / (4.0f * f->G));
2877 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2878 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback
2879}
2880
2881void tVZFilterBell_setFrequencyAndGain (tVZFilterBell const f, Lfloat freq, Lfloat gain)
2882{
2883 f->fc = freq;
2884 f->G = LEAF_clip(0.000001f, gain, 4000.0f);
2885 f->g = fastertanf(PI * freq * f->invSampleRate);
2886 Lfloat fl = f->fc * fastPowf(2.0f, (-f->B) * 0.5f); // lower bandedge frequency (in Hz)
2887 Lfloat wl = fastertanf(PI * fl * f->invSampleRate); // warped radian lower bandedge frequency /(2*fs)
2888 Lfloat r = f->g / wl;
2889 r *= r; // warped frequency ratio wu/wl == (wc/wl)^2 where wu is the
2890 // warped upper bandedge, wc the center
2891 f->rToUse = r;
2892 f->R2 = 2.0f * fastsqrtf(((r * r + 1.0f) / r - 2.0f) / (4.0f * f->G));
2893 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2894 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback
2895}

2897void tVZFilterBell_setFrequencyAndBandwidthAndGain (tVZFilterBell const f, Lfloat freq, Lfloat bandwidth, Lfloat gain)
2898{
2899 f->fc = freq;
2900 f->B = bandwidth;
2901 f->G = LEAF_clip(0.000001f, gain, 4000.0f);
2902 f->g = fastertanf(PI * freq * f->invSampleRate);
2903 Lfloat fl = f->fc * fastPowf(2.0f, (-f->B) * 0.5f); // lower bandedge frequency (in Hz)
2904 Lfloat wl = fastertanf(PI * fl * f->invSampleRate); // warped radian lower bandedge frequency /(2*fs)
2905 Lfloat r = f->g / wl;
2906 r *= r; // warped frequency ratio wu/wl == (wc/wl)^2 where wu is the
2907 // warped upper bandedge, wc the center
2908 f->rToUse = r;
2909 f->R2 = 2.0f * fastsqrtf(((r * r + 1.0f) / r - 2.0f) / (4.0f * f->G));
2910 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2911 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback

2914void tVZFilterBell_setFreqAndBWAndGainFast (tVZFilterBell const f, Lfloat cutoff, Lfloat BW, Lfloat gain)
2915{
2916 f->cutoffMIDI = cutoff;
2917 f->B = BW;
2918 cutoff *= 30.567164179104478f;
2919 int32_t intVer = (int32_t) cutoff;
2920 if (intVer > 4094) {
2921 intVer = 4094;
2922 }
2923 if (intVer < 0) {
2924 intVer = 0;
2925 }
2926 Lfloat LfloatVer = cutoff - (Lfloat) intVer;
2927 f->g = ((f->table[intVer] * (1.0f - LfloatVer)) + (f->table[intVer + 1] * LfloatVer)) * f->sampRatio;
2928 Lfloat fl = cutoff + (12.0f * (-f->B) * 0.5f); // lower bandedge frequency (in MIDI)
2929 intVer = (int32_t) fl;
2930 if (intVer > 4094) {
2931 intVer = 4094;
2932 }
2933 if (intVer < 0) {
2934 intVer = 0;
2935 }
2936 LfloatVer = fl - (Lfloat) intVer;
2937 Lfloat gLower = ((f->table[intVer] * (1.0f - LfloatVer)) + (f->table[intVer + 1] * LfloatVer)) * f->sampRatio;
2938
2939 Lfloat r = f->g / gLower;
2940 r *= r; // warped frequency ratio wu/wl == (wc/wl)^2 where wu is the
2941 // warped upper bandedge, wc the center
2942 f->rToUse = r;
2943 f->G = LEAF_clip(0.000001f, gain, 4000.0f);
2944 f->R2 = 2.0f * fastsqrtf(((f->rToUse * f->rToUse + 1.0f) / f->rToUse - 2.0f) / (4.0f * f->G));
2945 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2946 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback
2947
2948}

2961void tVZFilterBR_initToPool (tVZFilterBR *const vf, Lfloat freq, Lfloat Q, tMempool *const mp)
2962{
2963 _tMempool *m = *mp;
2964 _tVZFilterBR *f = *vf = (_tVZFilterBR *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tVZFilterBR), m);
2965 f->mempool = m;
2966
2967 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
2968
2969 f->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
2970 f->sampRatio = 48000.0f / f->sampleRate;
2971 f->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
2972 Lfloat fc = LEAF_clip(0.0f, freq, 0.5f * f->sampleRate);
2973 f->cutoffMIDI = ftom(freq);
2974 f->s1 = 0.0f;
2975 f->s2 = 0.0f;
2976 f->R2 = 1.0f / Q;
2977 f->G = 1.0f;
2978 f->g = tanf(PI * fc * f->invSampleRate);
2979 f->R2Plusg = f->R2 + f->g;
2980 f->h = 1.0f / (1.0f + (f->R2 * f->g) + (f->g * f->g)); // factor for feedback precomputation
2981 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {
2982 f->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
2983 } else {
2984 f->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
2985 }
2986}

3006Lfloat tVZFilterBR_tick (tVZFilterBR const f, Lfloat input)
3007{
3008 Lfloat yL, yB, yH, v1, v2;
3009
3010 // compute highpass output via Eq. 5.1:
3011 //yH = (in - f->R2*f->s1 - f->g*f->s1 - f->s2) * f->h;
3012 yH = (input - (f->R2Plusg * f->s1) - f->s2) * f->h;
3013 // compute bandpass output by applying 1st integrator to highpass output:
3014 v1 = f->g * yH;
3015 yB = v1 + f->s1;
3016 f->s1 = v1 + yB; // state update in 1st integrator
3017
3018 // compute lowpass output by applying 2nd integrator to bandpass output:
3019 v2 = f->g * yB;
3020 yL = v2 + f->s2;
3021 f->s2 = v2 + yL; // state update in 2nd integrator
3022
3023 return (yH + yL) * f->G;
3024}

3085/******************************************************************************/
3086/* Diode Filter */
3087/******************************************************************************/
3088
3089
3090//taken from Ivan C's model of the EMS diode ladder, based on mystran's code from KVR forums
3091//https://www.kvraudio.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=33&t=349859&start=255
3092
3093void tDiodeFilter_init (tDiodeFilter *const vf, Lfloat cutoff, Lfloat resonance,
3094 LEAF *const leaf)
3095{
3096 tDiodeFilter_initToPool(vf, cutoff, resonance, &leaf->mempool);
3097}
3098
3099void tDiodeFilter_initToPool (tDiodeFilter *const vf, Lfloat cutoff, Lfloat resonance,
3100 tMempool *const mp)
3101{
3102 _tMempool *m = *mp;
3103 _tDiodeFilter *f = *vf = (_tDiodeFilter *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tDiodeFilter), m);
3104 f->mempool = m;
3105
3106 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
3107
3108 f->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
3109 f->cutoff = cutoff;
3110 // initialization (the resonance factor is between 0 and 8 according to the article)
3111 f->f = (Lfloat) tan((double) (PI * cutoff * f->invSampleRate));
3112 f->cutoffMIDI = ftom(cutoff);
3113 f->r = (7.f * resonance + 0.5f);
3114 f->Vt = 0.5f;
3115 f->n = 1.836f;
3116 f->zi = 0.0f; //previous input value
3117 f->gamma = f->Vt * f->n;
3118 f->s0 = 0.01f;
3119 f->s1 = 0.02f;
3120 f->s2 = 0.03f;
3121 f->s3 = 0.04f;
3122 f->g0inv = 1.f / (2.f * f->Vt);
3123 f->g1inv = 1.f / (2.f * f->gamma);
3124 f->g2inv = 1.f / (6.f * f->gamma);
3125 f->sampRatio = 48000.0f / leaf->sampleRate;
3126 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {
3127 f->table = __filterTanhTable_96000;
3128 } else {
3129 f->table = __filterTanhTable_48000;
3130 }
3131}
3132
3133void tDiodeFilter_free (tDiodeFilter *const vf)
3134{
3135 _tDiodeFilter *f = *vf;
3136 mpool_free((char *) f, f->mempool);
3137}
3138
3139Lfloat tanhXdX (Lfloat x)
3140{
3141 Lfloat a = x * x;
3142 // IIRC I got this as Pade-approx for tanh(sqrt(x))/sqrt(x)
3143
3144 Lfloat testVal = ((15.0f * a + 420.0f) * a + 945.0f);
3145
3146 Lfloat output = 1.0f;
3147
3148 if (testVal > 0.000001f) {
3149 output = testVal;
3150
3151 }
3152 return ((a + 105.0f) * a + 945.0f) / output;
3153}
3154
3155
3156Lfloat tDiodeFilter_tick (tDiodeFilter const f, Lfloat in)
3157{
3158 // the input x[n+1] is given by 'in', and x[n] by zi
3159 // input with half delay
3160 Lfloat ih = 0.5f * (in + f->zi);
3161
3162 // evaluate the non-linear factors
3163 Lfloat t0 = f->f * tanhXdX((ih - f->r * f->s3) * f->g0inv) * f->g0inv;
3164 Lfloat t1 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s1 - f->s0) * f->g1inv) * f->g1inv;
3165 Lfloat t2 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s2 - f->s1) * f->g1inv) * f->g1inv;
3166 Lfloat t3 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s3 - f->s2) * f->g1inv) * f->g1inv;
3167 Lfloat t4 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s3) * f->g2inv) * f->g2inv;
3168
3169 // This formula gives the result for y3 thanks to MATLAB
3170 Lfloat y3 = (f->s2 + f->s3 + t2 * (f->s1 + f->s2 + f->s3 + t1 * (f->s0 + f->s1 + f->s2 + f->s3 + t0 * in)) +
3171 t1 * (2.0f * f->s2 + 2.0f * f->s3)) * t3 + f->s3 + 2.0f * f->s3 * t1 +
3172 t2 * (2.0f * f->s3 + 3.0f * f->s3 * t1);
3173
3174 Lfloat tempy3denom =
3175 (t4 + t1 * (2.0f * t4 + 4.0f) + t2 * (t4 + t1 * (t4 + f->r * t0 + 4.0f) + 3.0f) + 2.0f) * t3 + t4 +
3176 t1 * (2.0f * t4 + 2.0f) + t2 * (2.0f * t4 + t1 * (3.0f * t4 + 3.0f) + 2.0f) + 1.0f;
3177
3178 if (tempy3denom < 0.000001f) {
3179 tempy3denom = 0.000001f;
3180 }
3181 y3 = y3 / tempy3denom;
3182
3183 if (t1 < 0.000001f) {
3184 t1 = 0.000001f;
3185 }
3186 if (t2 < 0.000001f) {
3187 t2 = 0.000001f;
3188 }
3189 if (t3 < 0.000001f) {
3190 t3 = 0.000001f;
3191 }
3192 // Other outputs
3193 Lfloat y2 = (f->s3 - (1 + t4 + t3) * y3) / (-t3);
3194 Lfloat y1 = (f->s2 - (1 + t3 + t2) * y2 + t3 * y3) / (-t2);
3195 Lfloat y0 = (f->s1 - (1 + t2 + t1) * y1 + t2 * y2) / (-t1);
3196 Lfloat xx = (in - f->r * y3);
3197
3198 // update state
3199 f->s0 += 2.0f * (t0 * xx + t1 * (y1 - y0));
3200
3201 f->s1 += 2.0f * (t2 * (y2 - y1) - t1 * (y1 - y0));
3202 f->s2 += 2.0f * (t3 * (y3 - y2) - t2 * (y2 - y1));
3203 f->s3 += 2.0f * (-t4 * (y3) - t3 * (y3 - y2));
3204
3205 f->s0 = 1000.0f * tanhf(f->s0 * 0.001f);
3206 f->s1 = 1000.0f * tanhf(f->s1 * 0.001f);
3207 f->s2 = 1000.0f * tanhf(f->s2 * 0.001f);
3208 f->s3 = 1000.0f * tanhf(f->s3 * 0.001f);
3209 f->zi = in;
3210 return tanhf(y3 * f->r);
3211}
3212
3213Lfloat tDiodeFilter_tickEfficient (tDiodeFilter const f, Lfloat in)
3214{
3215 // the input x[n+1] is given by 'in', and x[n] by zi
3216 // input with half delay
3217 Lfloat ih = 0.5f * (in + f->zi);
3218
3219 // evaluate the non-linear factors
3220 Lfloat t0 = f->f * tanhXdX((ih - f->r * f->s3) * f->g0inv) * f->g0inv;
3221 Lfloat t1 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s1 - f->s0) * f->g1inv) * f->g1inv;
3222 Lfloat t2 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s2 - f->s1) * f->g1inv) * f->g1inv;
3223 Lfloat t3 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s3 - f->s2) * f->g1inv) * f->g1inv;
3224 Lfloat t4 = f->f * tanhXdX((f->s3) * f->g2inv) * f->g2inv;
3225
3226 // This formula gives the result for y3 thanks to MATLAB
3227 Lfloat y3 = (f->s2 + f->s3 + t2 * (f->s1 + f->s2 + f->s3 + t1 * (f->s0 + f->s1 + f->s2 + f->s3 + t0 * in)) +
3228 t1 * (2.0f * f->s2 + 2.0f * f->s3)) * t3 + f->s3 + 2.0f * f->s3 * t1 +
3229 t2 * (2.0f * f->s3 + 3.0f * f->s3 * t1);
3230
3231 Lfloat tempy3denom =
3232 (t4 + t1 * (2.0f * t4 + 4.0f) + t2 * (t4 + t1 * (t4 + f->r * t0 + 4.0f) + 3.0f) + 2.0f) * t3 + t4 +
3233 t1 * (2.0f * t4 + 2.0f) + t2 * (2.0f * t4 + t1 * (3.0f * t4 + 3.0f) + 2.0f) + 1.0f;
3234
3235 if (tempy3denom < 0.000001f) {
3236 tempy3denom = 0.000001f;
3237 }
3238
3239 y3 = y3 / tempy3denom;
3240
3241 if (t1 < 0.000001f) {
3242 t1 = 0.000001f;
3243 }
3244 if (t2 < 0.000001f) {
3245 t2 = 0.000001f;
3246 }
3247 if (t3 < 0.000001f) {
3248 t3 = 0.000001f;
3249 }
3250
3251 // Other outputs
3252 Lfloat y2 = (f->s3 - (1 + t4 + t3) * y3) / (-t3);
3253 Lfloat y1 = (f->s2 - (1 + t3 + t2) * y2 + t3 * y3) / (-t2);
3254 Lfloat y0 = (f->s1 - (1 + t2 + t1) * y1 + t2 * y2) / (-t1);
3255 Lfloat xx = (in - f->r * y3);
3256
3257 // update state
3258 f->s0 += 2.0f * (t0 * xx + t1 * (y1 - y0));
3259 f->s1 += 2.0f * (t2 * (y2 - y1) - t1 * (y1 - y0));
3260 f->s2 += 2.0f * (t3 * (y3 - y2) - t2 * (y2 - y1));
3261 f->s3 += 2.0f * (-t4 * (y3) - t3 * (y3 - y2));
3262
3263 f->s0 = 1000.0f * fast_tanh(f->s0 * 0.001f);
3264 f->s1 = 1000.0f * fast_tanh(f->s1 * 0.001f);
3265 f->s2 = 1000.0f * fast_tanh(f->s2 * 0.001f);
3266 f->s3 = 1000.0f * fast_tanh(f->s3 * 0.001f);
3267
3268 f->zi = in;
3269 return fast_tanh5(y3 * f->r);
3270}

3312/******************************************************************************/
3313/* Ladder Filter */
3314/******************************************************************************/
3315
3316
3317void tLadderFilter_init (tLadderFilter *const vf, Lfloat cutoff, Lfloat resonance,
3318 LEAF *const leaf)
3319{
3320 tLadderFilter_initToPool(vf, cutoff, resonance, &leaf->mempool);
3321}
3322
3323void tLadderFilter_initToPool (tLadderFilter *const vf, Lfloat cutoff,
3324 Lfloat resonance, tMempool *const mp)
3325{
3326 _tMempool *m = *mp;
3327 _tLadderFilter *f = *vf = (_tLadderFilter *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tLadderFilter), m);
3328 f->mempool = m;
3329
3330 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
3331
3332 f->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
3333 f->sampleRatio = 48000.0f / leaf->sampleRate;
3334 f->cutoff = cutoff;
3335 f->cutoffMIDI = ftom(cutoff);
3336 f->oversampling = 1;
3337 f->invOS = 1.0f;
3338 f->c = (Lfloat) tan((double) (PI * (cutoff / (Lfloat) f->oversampling) * f->invSampleRate));
3339 f->c2 = 2.0f * f->c;
3340 //resonance / feedback is from 0 to 4 for 100%, further "drives" feedback
3341 f->fb = (resonance * 8.0f);
3342
3343 // shaper coefficients, offset, scale, shape
3344 // very quick approximation, close enough for me to tanh
3345 // yet far more flexible
3346 f->a = 2.0f;
3347 f->s = 0.1f;
3348 f->d = 1.0f;
3349
3350
3351 f->b[0] = 0.01f;
3352 f->b[0] = 0.02f;
3353 f->b[0] = 0.03f;
3354 f->b[0] = 0.04f;
3355 if (leaf->sampleRate > 80000) {

3368Lfloat smoothABS (Lfloat x, const Lfloat y) // y controls 'smoothness' usually between 0.002 -> 0.04
3369{
3370 //possible speedup with sqrt CMSIS-DSP approximation? seems to resolve to just a normal call to sqrt. Maybe the vector version since there are two square roots to determine? -JS
3371// #ifdef ARM_MATH_CM7
3372// Lfloat output1;
3373// Lfloat output2;
3374// arm_sqrt_f32((x * x) + y, &output1);
3375// arm_sqrt_f32(y, &output2);
3376// return output1 - output2;
3377// #else
3378 return (sqrtf((x * x) + y)) - sqrtf(y);
3379// #endif
3380}

3382Lfloat smoothclip (Lfloat x, const Lfloat a, const Lfloat b) // assuming symmetrical clipping
3383{
3384 Lfloat x1 = smoothABS(x - a, 0.01f);
3385 Lfloat x2 = smoothABS(x - b, 0.01f);
3386 x = x1 + (a + b);
3387 x = x - x2;
3388 x = x * 0.5f;
3389 return (x);
3390}
3391
3392Lfloat tanhd (const Lfloat x, const Lfloat d, const Lfloat s)
3393{
3394 return 1.0f - s * (d + 1.0f) * x * x / (d + x * x);
3395}
3396
3397Lfloat tLadderFilter_tick (tLadderFilter const f, Lfloat in)
3398{
3399 Lfloat y3 = 0.0f;
3400 in += 0.015f;
3401 // per-sample computation
3402 for (int i = 0; i < f->oversampling; i++) {
3403 Lfloat t0 = tanhd(f->b[0] + f->a, f->d, f->s);
3404 Lfloat t1 = tanhd(f->b[1] + f->a, f->d, f->s);
3405 Lfloat t2 = tanhd(f->b[2] + f->a, f->d, f->s);
3406 Lfloat t3 = tanhd(f->b[3] + f->a, f->d, f->s);
3407
3408 Lfloat den0 = 1.0f / (1.0f + f->c * t0);
3409 Lfloat den1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + f->c * t1);
3410 Lfloat den2 = 1.0f / (1.0f + f->c * t2);
3411 Lfloat den3 = 1.0f / (1.0f + f->c * t3);
3412 Lfloat g0 = 1.0f * den0;
3413 Lfloat g1 = 1.0f * den1;
3414 Lfloat g2 = 1.0f * den2;
3415 Lfloat g3 = 1.0f * den3;
3416
3417 Lfloat z0 = f->c * t0 * den0;
3418 Lfloat z1 = f->c * t1 * den1;
3419 Lfloat z2 = f->c * t2 * den2;
3420 Lfloat z3 = f->c * t3 * den3;
3421
3422 Lfloat f3 = f->c * t2 * g3;
3423 Lfloat f2 = f->c * f->c * t1 * g2 * t2 * g3;
3424 Lfloat f1 = f->c * f->c * f->c * t0 * g1 * t1 * g2 * t2 * g3;
3425 Lfloat f0 = f->c * f->c * f->c * f->c * g0 * t0 * g1 * t1 * g2 * t2 * g3;
3426
3427 Lfloat estimate =
3428 g3 * f->b[3] +
3429 f3 * g2 * f->b[2] +
3430 f2 * g1 * f->b[1] +
3431 f1 * g0 * f->b[0] +
3432 f0 * in;
3433
3434 // feedback gain coefficient, absolutely critical to get this correct
3435 // i believe in the original this is computed incorrectly?
3436 Lfloat cgfbr = 1.0f / (1.0f + f->fb * z0 * z1 * z2 * z3);
3437
3438 // clamp can be a hard clip, a diode + highpass is better
3439 // if you implement a highpass do not forget to include it in the computation of the gain coefficients!
3440 Lfloat xx = in - smoothclip(f->fb * estimate, -1.0f, 1.0f) * cgfbr;
3441 Lfloat y0 = t0 * g0 * (f->b[0] + f->c * xx);
3442 Lfloat y1 = t1 * g1 * (f->b[1] + f->c * y0);
3443 Lfloat y2 = t2 * g2 * (f->b[2] + f->c * y1);
3444 y3 = t3 * g3 * (f->b[3] + f->c * y2);
3445
3446 // update the stored state
3447 f->b[0] += f->c2 * (xx - y0);
3448 f->b[1] += f->c2 * (y0 - y1);
3449 f->b[2] += f->c2 * (y1 - y2);
3450 f->b[3] += f->c2 * (y2 - y3);
3451 }
3452
3453 // you must limit the compensation if feedback is clamped
3454 Lfloat compensation = 1.0f + smoothclip(f->fb, 0.0f, 4.0f);
3455 return fast_tanh5(y3 * compensation);
3456}

3458void tLadderFilter_setFreq (tLadderFilter const f, Lfloat cutoff)
3459{
3460 f->cutoff = LEAF_clip(40.0f, cutoff, 18000.0f);
3461 f->c = tanf(PI * (f->cutoff * f->invOS) * f->invSampleRate);
3462 f->c2 = 2.0f * f->c;
3463}
3464
3465void tLadderFilter_setFreqFast (tLadderFilter const f, Lfloat cutoff)
3466{
3467 cutoff += 3.0f;
3468 f->cutoffMIDI = cutoff;
3469 cutoff *= 30.567164179104478f;
3470
3471 int32_t intVer = (int32_t) cutoff;
3472 if (intVer > 4094) {
3473 intVer = 4094;
3474 }
3475 if (intVer < 0) {
3476 intVer = 0;
3477 }
3478 Lfloat LfloatVer = cutoff - (Lfloat) intVer;
3479
3480 f->c = ((f->table[intVer] * (1.0f - LfloatVer)) + (f->table[intVer + 1] * LfloatVer)) * f->sampleRatio;
3481 f->c2 = 2.0f * f->c;
3482}

3520void tTiltFilter_init (tTiltFilter *const vf, Lfloat cutoff, LEAF *const leaf)
3521{
3522 tTiltFilter_initToPool(vf, cutoff, &leaf->mempool);
3523}
3524
3525void tTiltFilter_initToPool (tTiltFilter *const vf, Lfloat cutoff, tMempool *const mp)
3526{
3527 _tMempool *m = *mp;
3528 _tTiltFilter *f = *vf = (_tTiltFilter *) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tTiltFilter), m);
3529 f->mempool = m;
3530
3531 LEAF *leaf = f->mempool->leaf;
3532 f->cutoff = cutoff;
3533 f->invAmp = 1.0f / (6.0f / logf(2.0f));
3534 f->gfactor = 5.0f;
3535
3536
3537 f->sr3 = leaf->sampleRate * 3.0f;
3538 Lfloat omega = TWO_PI * cutoff;
3539 Lfloat n = 1.0f / (f->sr3 + omega);
3540 f->a0 = 2.0f * omega * n;
3541 f->b1 = (f->sr3 - omega) * n;
3542}

3551Lfloat tTiltFilter_tick (tTiltFilter const f, Lfloat in)
3552{
3553 f->lp_out = f->a0 * in + f->b1 * f->lp_out;
3554 return in + f->lgain * f->lp_out + f->hgain * (in - f->lp_out);
3555}
3556
3557void tTiltFilter_setTilt (tTiltFilter const f, Lfloat tilt)
3558{
3559 Lfloat g1;
3560 Lfloat g2;
3561 if (tilt > 0.0f) {
3562 g1 = -f->gfactor * tilt;
3563 g2 = tilt;
3564 } else {
3565 g1 = -tilt;
3566 g2 = f->gfactor * tilt;
3567 }
3568
3569 //two separate gains
3570 f->lgain = fasterexpf(g1 * f->invAmp) - 1.0f;
3571 f->hgain = fasterexpf(g2 * f->invAmp) - 1.0f;
3572}

3574void tTiltFilter_setSampleRate (tTiltFilter const f, Lfloat sr)
